## What Happened This Month

**Win:** Both PC-01 and PC-02 are fully booked for July 4 weekend at premium pricing ($1,495 PC-02 ADR for the holiday week — the highest rate either unit has ever booked). Bookings filled within 6 days of opening the calendar.

**Watch:** Ski-season demand dropped sharply after the resort closed Apr 19. Five years running, this is when shoulder-season hits. Our pricing engine (PriceLabs) auto-adjusted ADR down 18% on weekday inventory — this is intentional and protects RevPAR vs. holding price and getting zero bookings.

**Coming next month:** Your summer pricing kicks in May 18 (Memorial Day weekend rates). Both your properties have summer occupancy projected at 78% — well above the 68% portfolio target — driven by Canyons Village's strong summer mountain-biking and family scene.
